chunks: And from him, from Fadala, from Rifa'ah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about visiting the House (Kaaba) during the days of Tashriq, and he said: 'It is good (hasan).'

key_terms.التَّشْرِيقِ: The days of Tashriq (11th-13th Dhu al-Hijjah) following Eid al-Adha
key_terms.حَسَنٌ: Good/Excellent (a technical term in Shia hadith indicating recommendation or virtue)

ai.seo_question: Is it recommended to visit the Kaaba for optional prayer during the days of Tashriq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Rifa'ah ibn al-Mugheerah inquires of Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about performing optional tawaf at the Kaaba during the Days of Tashriq, to which the Imam replies 'Hasan' (good/excellent). This concise response affirms the permissibility and spiritual merit of extending one's pilgrimage rituals beyond the core days of Hajj, reflecting the Shia emphasis on voluntary acts of worship that deepen devotion during sacred times. The narration highlights the flexibility within Shia jurisprudence regarding post-Hajj rituals, encouraging believers to maintain a state of spiritual connection with the House of God.
